main_measure.name: t-stat of slope of excess next-24-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping blocks, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with in-zone falling share > 50%; reject if slope t <= -2; at least 60 in-zone blocks

supporting_check.name: in-zone share of blocks with excess 24-bar return < 0 (binomial vs 50%, one-sided p = 0.5615)

decided_by: Slope t lies between -2 and 2: inconclusive.
reading: The window's mean 24-bar return is taken as the mean of that window's non-overlapping grid-block returns (blocks at positions 0, 24, 48, ... with a full 24 bars ahead in the window), the slope t is the OLS slope over its standard error, and the supporting check passes when the share is above 50%.
